about_short_description.short_description: Grintafy Technologies is operates a talent discovery platform for amateur footballers.

product.name: Grintafy Football Talent Discovery Platform
product.description: A digital platform that connects amateur football players with clubs, scouts, and opportunities worldwide by enabling players to create profiles, showcase skills, and participate in games and tryouts.

identifier.value: Grintafy Game Organization and Payment System

product.name: Grintafy Game Organization and Payment System
product.description: A feature within the platform that enables users to create football games, invite players, communicate via messaging, and handle game fee payments through various online methods or in-app currency.

identifier.value: Grintafy Digital Player CVs and Media Showcase

product.name: Grintafy Digital Player CVs and Media Showcase
product.description: A service that allows football players to build and maintain digital profiles with media uploads to showcase their skills and performance to scouts and clubs.

identifier.value: Grintafy Tryouts and Talent Discovery Events

product.name: Grintafy Tryouts and Talent Discovery Events
product.description: Organized football tryouts and talent discovery events conducted in partnership with local and international football federations and clubs to identify and recruit promising players.

identifier.value: Grintafy Web3 and Blockchain Integration for Talent Discovery

product.name: Grintafy Web3 and Blockchain Integration for Talent Discovery
product.description: An initiative to incorporate Web3 and blockchain technologies into the platform to enhance transparency, security, and innovation in football talent discovery and player engagement.
